text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا

translations.asad: HAS THERE [not] been an endless span of time before man [appeared - a time] when he was not yet a thing to be thought of?
translations.sahih: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

text.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

translations.asad: Verily, it is We who have created man out of a drop of sperm intermingled, so that We might try him [in his later life]: and therefore We made him a being endowed with hearing and sight.
translations.sahih: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

text.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

translations.asad: Verily, We have shown him the way: [and it rests with him to prove himself] either grateful or ungrateful.
translations.sahih: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

text.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا

translations.asad: [Now,] behold, for those who deny the truth We have readied chains and shackles, and a blazing flame
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

text.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

translations.asad: [whereas,] behold, the truly virtuous shall drink from a cup flavoured with the calyx of sweet-smelling flowers:
translations.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,

text.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا

translations.asad: a source [of bliss] whereof God's servants shall drink, seeing it flow in a flow abundant.
translations.sahih: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

text.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا

translations.asad: [The truly virtuous are] they [who] fulfil their vows, and stand in awe of a Day the woe of which is bound to spread far and wide,
translations.sahih: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

text.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا

translations.asad: and who give food - however great be their own want of it - unto the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,
translations.sahih: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

text.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا

translations.asad: [saying, in their hearts,] "We feed you for the sake of God alone: we desire no recompense from you, nor thanks:
translations.sahih: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

text.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا

translations.asad: behold, we stand in awe of our Sustainer's judgment on a distressful, fateful Day!"
translations.sahih: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

text.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا

translations.asad: And so, God will preserve them from the woes of that Day, and will bestow on them brightness and joy,
translations.sahih: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

text.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا

translations.asad: and will reward them for all their patience in adversity with a garden [of bliss] and with [garments of] silk.
translations.sahih: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

text.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا

translations.asad: In that [garden] they will on couches recline, and will know therein neither [burning] sun nor cold severe,
translations.sahih: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

text.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا

translations.asad: since its [blissful] shades will come down low over them, and low will hang down its clusters of fruit, most easy to reach.
translations.sahih: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

text.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠

translations.asad: And they will be waited upon with vessels of silver and goblets that will [seem to] be crystal –
translations.sahih: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

text.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا

translations.asad: crystal-like, [but] of silver - the measure whereof they alone will determine.
translations.sahih: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

text.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

translations.asad: And in that [paradise] they will be given to drink of a cup flavoured with ginger,
translations.sahih: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

text.arabic: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا

translations.asad: [derived from] a source [to be found] therein, whose name is "Seek Thy Way".
translations.sahih: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.

text.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا

translations.asad: And immortal youths will wait upon them: when thou seest them, thou wouldst deem them to be scattered pearls;
translations.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

text.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا

translations.asad: and when thou seest [anything that is] there thou wilt see [only] bliss and a realm transcendent
translations.sahih: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

text.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا

translations.asad: Upon those [blest] will be garments of green silk and brocade; and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Sustainer will them to drink of a drink most pure.
translations.sahih: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

text.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

translations.asad: [And they will be told:] "Verily, all this is your reward since Your endeavour [in life] has met [God's] goodly acceptance!"
translations.sahih: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

text.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا

translations.asad: VERILY, [O believer,] it is We who have bestowed from on high this Qur’an upon thee, step by step - truly a bestowal from on high!
translations.sahih: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.

text.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا

translations.asad: Await, then, in all patience thy Sustainer's judgment, and pay no heed to any of them, who is a wilful sinner or an ingrate;
translations.sahih: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

text.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا

translations.asad: and bear in mind thy Sustainer's name at morn and evening
translations.sahih: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

text.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا

translations.asad: and during some of the night, and prostrate thyself before Him, and extol His limitless glory throughout the long night.
translations.sahih: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.

text.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا

translations.asad: Behold, they [who are unmindful of God] love this fleeting life, and leave behind them [all thought of] a grief-laden Day.
translations.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

text.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

translations.asad: [They will not admit to themselves that] it We who have created them and strengthened their make - and [that] if it be Our will We can replace them entirely with others of their kind.
translations.sahih: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

text.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا

translations.asad: VERILY, all this is an admonition: whoever, then, so wills, may unto his Sustainer find a way.
translations.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

text.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا

translations.asad: But you cannot will it unless God wills [to show you that way]: for, behold, God is indeed all-seeing, wise.
translations.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.

text.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا

translations.asad: He admits unto His grace everyone who wills [to be admitted]; but as for the evildoers - for them has He readied grievous suffering [in the life to come].
translations.sahih: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
